## What changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List commands and results, OS, relevant app/output checks, and any skipped or
unverified checks. For code changes, include `python -m pytest -q -ra` results.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, with relevant regression coverage or an explanation
      of why tests are unnecessary.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed workflow or setup.
- [ ] Commits and attachments contain no real school/customer data, panel user
      codes, credentials, network settings, or generated build output.

Use fictional data in screenshots and examples. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/l1quid8/c1-dmp-toolkit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
